source_locations.location: Experimental Section, Magnetic Measurements; Results, Magnetism

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete sandwich-type polyoxometalate in which a tetracerium(IV) core with two μ3-oxo bridges is bound between two trivacant [SiW9O34] units. The two external Ce centers each also bind a chelating acetate ligand. Each Ce center has an eight-coordinate, approximately square-antiprismatic oxygen environment. Compound 1 is isostructural with the uranium analogue 2.

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate in 1 M sodium acetate buffer, add solid Na10[SiW9O34]·12H2O, and heat at 50 °C for 30 min until the yellowish solid dissolves. Add CsNO3 and heat for a further 15 min at 50 °C. Cool to room temperature and allow slow evaporation.
solvents: 5 mL of 1 M sodium acetate buffer
synthesis.temperature: 50 °C during preparation; room temperature during crystallization
synthesis.time: 30 min heating, then 15 min heating; crystals appeared after 1 day and were collected after 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Heated solution followed by slow-evaporation crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow crystals appeared after 1 day. After 1 week, they were filtered, washed with a small amount of water, and dried at room temperature.

title: Stabilization of Tetravalent 4f (Ce), 5d (Hf), or 5f (Th, U) Clusters by the [α-SiW9O34]10− Polyoxometalate
